steps.headline: caffeine (C8H10N4O2, 194.19 g/mol), by GFN2-xTB: its strongest IR band is at 1712 cm-1, the C=O stretch, its dipole is 3.98 D, dissolving in water is worth -43.9 kJ/mol. At 298 K its entropy is 470.8 J/(mol K) and its heat capacity 211.0 J/(mol K).
